h2: Range Rover TDV6 / SDV6 Timing Chain Issues?||
description: We replace timing chains, tensioners and injector seals as standard on every TDV6/SDV6 rebuild where worn or damaged. This engine family is also associated with crankshaft bearing wear at higher mileages, and separately, with known air suspension compressor/valve block faults - while air suspension isn't part of our engine rebuild service, it's worth knowing about if your Range Rover is showing ride-height or compressor warning symptoms alongside engine concerns.

callout.title: A Well-Documented Issue
callout.body: TDV6/SDV6 timing chain and injector seal wear is widely documented across Land Rover specialist forums, independent garages and multiple TSBs.
